newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Q1 chain store sales up 8.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel Q1 chain store sales up 8.9 pct.

text.p: Israeli chain store sales rose by an annualised 8.9 percent In the first quarter of the year in comparison with the fourth quarter of 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Sunday.
In October-December 1996 chain store sales grew by an annualised 6.4, the bureau said.
Food sales rose in the first three months of the year by an annualised 11.0 percent, after an increase of 13.2 percent in the previous quarter.
The preliminary figures take into account seasonal factors, the government bureau said.
